title.en: Lost NY Medicaid or Essential Plan 2026? Your Options
title.es: Perdio Medicaid o Plan Esencial NY 2026? Sus Opciones

description.en: Lost NY Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage in 2026? You have 90 days to enroll in a new plan. Compare ACA marketplace, Medicaid, and Essential Plan options.
description.es: Perdio cobertura Medicaid o Plan Esencial de NY en 2026? Tiene 90 dias para inscribirse. Compare ACA, Medicaid y Plan Esencial.

h1.en: Lost NY Medicaid or Essential Plan in 2026? Here Are Your Next Steps
h1.es: Perdio Medicaid o el Plan Esencial de NY en 2026? Aqui Estan Sus Proximos Pasos

subhero.en: You have 90 days from the date your Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage ended to enroll in a new Qualified Health Plan through NY State of Health. For the July 1, 2026 Essential Plan cut, that window closes August 30, 2026.
subhero.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termino su cobertura de Medicaid o Plan Esencial para inscribirse en un nuevo plan de salud a traves de NY State of Health. Para el corte del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio de 2026, esa ventana cierra el 30 de agosto de 2026.

heading.en: You have 90 days from the date your NY Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage ended
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termino su cobertura de Medicaid o Plan Esencial de NY

body.en: Loss of Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) at NY State of Health. For most people affected by the July 1, 2026 Essential Plan income-limit cut, the SEP window runs July 1 through September 29, 2026. NY State of Health confirmed an extended enrollment deadline of August 30, 2026 for plan-year transitions. Miss this window and you may have to wait until the next ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026 for January 2027 coverage. Medicaid re-enrollment is year-round if your income drops below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level.
body.es: La perdida de cobertura Medicaid o Plan Esencial activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 90 dias en NY State of Health. Para la mayoria de personas afectadas por el corte del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio de 2026, la ventana del SEP va del 1 de julio al 29 de septiembre de 2026. NY State of Health confirmo una fecha limite de inscripcion ampliada al 30 de agosto de 2026 para transiciones de ano de plan. Si pierde esta ventana, puede tener que esperar hasta la proxima Inscripcion Abierta en noviembre de 2026 para cobertura de enero 2027. La reinscripcion en Medicaid es todo el ano si su ingreso cae por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza.

quickAnswer.en: Losing NY Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage in 2026 triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period at NY State of Health. Your three main paths are: (1) re-enroll in Essential Plan if your income is under 200% of the Federal Poverty Level (about $31,920 per year for one person in 2026), (2) enroll in Medicaid year-round if your income is under 138% FPL (about $22,025 for one person), or (3) enroll in a Qualified Health Plan through NY State of Health with ACA premium tax credits if your income is between 100% and 400% FPL. The July 1, 2026 Essential Plan cut affects roughly 450,000 New Yorkers at 200-250% FPL whose plans ended June 30, 2026.
quickAnswer.es: Perder cobertura de Medicaid o Plan Esencial de NY en 2026 activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias en NY State of Health. Sus tres caminos principales son: (1) reinscribirse en el Plan Esencial si su ingreso esta bajo el 200% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza (aproximadamente $31,920 al ano para una persona en 2026), (2) inscribirse en Medicaid todo el ano si su ingreso esta bajo el 138% FPL (aproximadamente $22,025 para una persona), o (3) inscribirse en un Plan de Salud Calificado a traves de NY State of Health con creditos fiscales de prima ACA si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL. El corte del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio de 2026 afecta a aproximadamente 450,000 neoyorquinos al 200-250% FPL cuyos planes terminaron el 30 de junio de 2026.

introParagraphs.en: New York's Essential Plan underwent a major eligibility cut on July 1, 2026. The income threshold dropped from 250% of the Federal Poverty Level to 200% FPL. Roughly 450,000 New Yorkers at 200-250% FPL lost their Essential Plan coverage on June 30, 2026. Essential Plan enrollees paid $0 in monthly premiums and had minimal cost-sharing. Qualified Health Plans at the same income range, even with ACA premium tax credits, carry monthly premiums and deductibles of several thousand dollars. The reason for the cut: federal H.R. 1 signed in July 2025 eliminated premium tax credit eligibility for most lawfully present immigrants, making the expanded Essential Plan financially unsustainable for New York State under its Section 1332 waiver structure. CMS approved New York's waiver termination request and authorized return to Basic Health Program authority, preserving coverage for the 1.3 million enrollees under 200% FPL while requiring those at 200-250% FPL to transition to Marketplace Qualified Health Plans. New Yorkers losing their Essential Plan or Medicaid due to a renewal redetermination in 2026 have 90 days from coverage loss to enroll in a new plan through NY State of Health at nystateofhealth.ny.gov.
introParagraphs.es: El Plan Esencial de Nueva York experimento un recorte importante de elegibilidad el 1 de julio de 2026. El umbral de ingresos bajo del 250% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza al 200% FPL. Aproximadamente 450,000 neoyorquinos al 200-250% FPL perdieron su cobertura del Plan Esencial el 30 de junio de 2026. Los inscritos en el Plan Esencial pagaban $0 en primas mensuales y tenian costos minimos compartidos. Los Planes de Salud Calificados en el mismo rango de ingresos, incluso con creditos fiscales de prima ACA, tienen primas mensuales y deducibles de varios miles de dolares. El motivo del recorte: la ley federal H.R. 1 firmada en julio de 2025 elimino la elegibilidad al credito fiscal de prima para la mayoria de inmigrantes legalmente presentes, haciendo que el Plan Esencial ampliado fuera financieramente insostenible para el Estado de Nueva York. CMS aprobo la solicitud de terminacion de la exencion de Nueva York y autorizo el regreso a la autoridad del Programa Basico de Salud, preservando la cobertura para los 1.3 millones de inscritos bajo el 200% FPL mientras requeria que los que estan al 200-250% FPL hicieran la transicion a Planes de Salud Calificados del Mercado.

introParagraphs.en: Separately, many New Yorkers lost full Medicaid during the 2023-2025 Medicaid unwinding after the end of the COVID public health emergency continuous-enrollment protections. Ongoing 2026 Medicaid redeterminations continue to remove some enrollees from Medicaid for procedural reasons, income changes, or household changes. Loss of Medicaid in New York also triggers the same 90-day Special Enrollment Period for Qualified Health Plans. Both situations (Essential Plan loss and Medicaid loss) feed into the same enrollment pathway at NY State of Health. This guide covers what to check first (can you stay on Medicaid or Essential Plan at a lower income tier?), what documents to gather, and how to enroll in an ACA Marketplace Qualified Health Plan before your 90-day window closes. Use NY State of Health at nystateofhealth.ny.gov as your primary enrollment portal, not healthcare.gov, since New York runs its own state-based Marketplace and all NY coverage options flow through the state portal.
introParagraphs.es: Por separado, muchos neoyorquinos perdieron el Medicaid completo durante el desenrollamiento de Medicaid 2023-2025 despues del fin de las protecciones de inscripcion continua de la emergencia de salud publica de COVID. Las redeterminaciones de Medicaid en 2026 siguen eliminando a algunos inscritos de Medicaid por razones de procedimiento, cambios de ingresos o cambios en el hogar. La perdida de Medicaid en Nueva York tambien activa el mismo Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para los Planes de Salud Calificados. Ambas situaciones alimentan la misma via de inscripcion en NY State of Health. Esta guia cubre que verificar primero (puede permanecer en Medicaid o Plan Esencial en un nivel de ingresos mas bajo?), que documentos reunir y como inscribirse en un Plan de Salud Calificado del Mercado ACA antes de que cierre su ventana de 90 dias.

name.en: Confirm why your coverage ended and your exact loss date
name.es: Confirme por que termino su cobertura y la fecha exacta de perdida

text.en: Log in to your NY State of Health account at nystateofhealth.ny.gov or call 1-855-355-5777 to confirm the exact date your Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage ended. Your 90-day SEP window starts the day after coverage loss. For the July 1, 2026 Essential Plan cut, your window opens July 1 and closes September 29, 2026, with NY State of Health accepting applications through August 30, 2026 for the plan year.
text.es: Inicie sesion en su cuenta de NY State of Health en nystateofhealth.ny.gov o llame al 1-855-355-5777 para confirmar la fecha exacta en que termino su cobertura de Medicaid o Plan Esencial. Su ventana de SEP de 90 dias comienza el dia despues de la perdida de cobertura. Para el corte del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio de 2026, su ventana se abre el 1 de julio y cierra el 29 de septiembre de 2026.

name.en: Calculate your current projected household income for 2026
name.es: Calcule su ingreso del hogar proyectado para 2026

text.en: Use only what your household will actually earn from today through December 31, 2026. Do not use last year's tax return income if your situation changed. In 2026, the key income thresholds for a single person in New York are: under $22,025 qualifies for full Medicaid; $22,025 to $31,920 qualifies for the Essential Plan (under 200% FPL); $31,920 to $63,840 qualifies for ACA premium tax credits in a Qualified Health Plan. For a family of 4, the 2026 thresholds are: under $45,540 for Medicaid, under $66,000 for Essential Plan, and under $132,000 for ACA subsidies.
text.es: Use solo lo que su hogar ganara realmente desde hoy hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2026. No use los ingresos de su declaracion de impuestos del ano pasado si su situacion cambio. En 2026, los umbrales de ingreso clave para una persona en Nueva York son: menos de $22,025 califica para Medicaid completo; $22,025 a $31,920 califica para el Plan Esencial (bajo el 200% FPL); $31,920 a $63,840 califica para creditos fiscales ACA en un Plan de Salud Calificado. Para una familia de 4, los umbrales de 2026 son: menos de $45,540 para Medicaid, menos de $66,000 para Plan Esencial y menos de $132,000 para subsidios ACA.

name.en: Check if you qualify for Medicaid or Essential Plan at a lower income tier
name.es: Verifique si califica para Medicaid o Plan Esencial en un nivel de ingreso mas bajo

text.en: Apply at nystateofhealth.ny.gov or call 1-855-355-5777. If your current income is under 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of 4 in 2026), apply for Medicaid year-round with no deadline. If your income is between 138% and 200% FPL, the Essential Plan continues to be available with $0 premiums. If your income dropped since your renewal determination, you may re-qualify for a tier you lost. New York Medicaid uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) and processes applications year-round.
text.es: Solicite en nystateofhealth.ny.gov o llame al 1-855-355-5777. Si su ingreso actual esta bajo el 138% FPL ($22,025 individual, $45,540 familia de 4 en 2026), solicite Medicaid todo el ano sin fecha limite. Si su ingreso esta entre el 138% y el 200% FPL, el Plan Esencial sigue disponible con primas de $0. Si sus ingresos bajaron desde su determinacion de renovacion, puede recalificar para un nivel que perdio.

name.en: If income is 200-400% FPL, compare Qualified Health Plans at NY State of Health
name.es: Si el ingreso esta entre 200-400% FPL, compare Planes de Salud Calificados en NY State of Health

text.en: Log in to nystateofhealth.ny.gov and use the SEP enrollment option triggered by your coverage loss notice. Compare Silver-level Qualified Health Plans, which offer the best balance of premium and out-of-pocket costs for most people. ACA premium tax credits for 2026 are available between 100% and 400% FPL. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits expired January 1, 2026. NY State confirmed that mid-year Essential Plan to QHP transitions will receive a reduced mid-year deductible equal to half the plan-year deductible.
text.es: Inicie sesion en nystateofhealth.ny.gov y use la opcion de inscripcion SEP activada por su aviso de perdida de cobertura. Compare los Planes de Salud Calificados de nivel Silver, que ofrecen el mejor equilibrio entre prima y costos de bolsillo para la mayoria de personas. Los creditos fiscales de prima ACA para 2026 estan disponibles entre el 100% y el 400% FPL. El precipicio del subsidio del 400% FPL volvio para 2026 despues de que expiraron los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados el 1 de enero de 2026.

name.en: Gather your documents before submitting the enrollment application
name.es: Reuna sus documentos antes de enviar la solicitud de inscripcion

text.en: Collect your Medicaid or Essential Plan termination letter (proof of coverage loss and loss date), Social Security numbers for all household members, most recent pay stubs or other proof of current income, immigration documents if applicable, and current home address for ZIP-code-based plan availability. NY State of Health may also request a copy of your 1095-B (Medicaid coverage statement) or prior-year 1095-A to verify coverage history.
text.es: Reuna su carta de terminacion de Medicaid o Plan Esencial (prueba de perdida de cobertura y fecha de perdida), numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar, recibos de pago mas recientes u otra prueba de ingreso actual, documentos de inmigracion si corresponde y su direccion actual para disponibilidad de planes por codigo postal.

name.en: Submit your enrollment application at NY State of Health within your 90-day window
name.es: Envie su solicitud de inscripcion en NY State of Health dentro de su ventana de 90 dias

text.en: Complete enrollment online at nystateofhealth.ny.gov, by phone at 1-855-355-5777, or in person with an enrollment assister. Select your qualifying event as 'lost Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage.' Coverage on an ACA Qualified Health Plan typically starts the first of the month after you enroll. For the July 1, 2026 Essential Plan transition, those enrolled by August 1 receive August 1 start dates. Those enrolled after August 1 receive a September 1 start date. New York State of Health assisters speak multiple languages and are available Monday through Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m. to 1 p.m.
text.es: Complete la inscripcion en linea en nystateofhealth.ny.gov, por telefono al 1-855-355-5777, o en persona con un asistente de inscripcion. Seleccione su evento calificador como 'perdida de cobertura Medicaid o Plan Esencial.' La cobertura en un Plan de Salud Calificado ACA generalmente comienza el primero del mes despues de inscribirse. Para la transicion del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio de 2026, quienes se inscriban antes del 1 de agosto reciben fechas de inicio del 1 de agosto. Quienes se inscriban despues del 1 de agosto reciben una fecha de inicio del 1 de septiembre.

name.en: File your 2026 taxes and reconcile the 1095-A if you received ACA subsidies
name.es: Presente sus impuestos de 2026 y concilie el 1095-A si recibio subsidios ACA

text.en: If you enrolled in a Qualified Health Plan mid-year with ACA premium tax credits, NY State of Health will mail you a 1095-A form in early 2027. Use Form 8962 to reconcile your actual premium tax credits against the advance amounts paid on your behalf during 2026. Report any income changes to NY State of Health promptly during the year to avoid a large repayment at tax time. Medicaid and Essential Plan enrollees receive a 1095-B, not a 1095-A, and do not need to reconcile premium tax credits.
text.es: Si se inscribio en un Plan de Salud Calificado a mitad de ano con creditos fiscales de prima ACA, NY State of Health le enviara por correo un formulario 1095-A a principios de 2027. Use el Formulario 8962 para conciliar sus creditos fiscales de prima reales con los montos anticipados pagados en su nombre durante 2026. Reporte cualquier cambio de ingresos a NY State of Health de inmediato durante el ano para evitar un gran reembolso en la temporada de impuestos.

en: Missing the 90-day SEP window: applications submitted more than 90 days after coverage loss are denied enrollment outside Open Enrollment Period
Unable to document the qualifying event: no termination letter on file or letter does not show the coverage end date; call 1-855-355-5777 to request a replacement termination notice

Income reported as prior-year annual income rather than current projected income: Medicaid and Essential Plan use MAGI and current-year projections; a higher prior-year income may incorrectly deny you the Essential Plan tier you qualify for now
Enrolling through healthcare.gov instead of NY State of Health: New York is a state-based Marketplace; healthcare.gov does not process NY applications and will route you incorrectly

Failing to report income to 200% FPL threshold correctly: immigrants using MAGI rules and some income types (child support, disability) can cause miscalculation; use nystateofhealth.ny.gov's income calculator or call for an enrollment assister

Ingresos reportados como ingreso anual del ano anterior en lugar del ingreso proyectado actual: Medicaid y el Plan Esencial usan MAGI y proyecciones del ano actual; un ingreso anterior mas alto puede negarle incorrectamente el nivel del Plan Esencial para el que califica ahora
Inscribirse a traves de healthcare.gov en lugar de NY State of Health: Nueva York es un Mercado basado en el estado; healthcare.gov no procesa solicitudes de NY y lo enrutara incorrectamente

heading.en: Essential Plan vs Medicaid vs Marketplace QHP: Which Path Is Right for You?
heading.es: Plan Esencial vs Medicaid vs Plan Calificado Mercado: Cual Camino Es el Correcto para Usted?

body.en: Three distinct tiers of coverage are available through NY State of Health in 2026, and which one applies depends almost entirely on your current projected income. Full Medicaid covers anyone at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level in New York, which means $22,025 or less for a single person. Medicaid in New York charges $0 in premiums and $0 to $1 in most copays; enrollment is year-round with no deadline. The Essential Plan is New York's Basic Health Program covering incomes between 138% and 200% FPL ($22,025 to $31,920 for a single person in 2026). Essential Plan enrollees pay $0 in monthly premiums and face an annual copay cap of roughly $200. Enrollment in the Essential Plan is also year-round through NY State of Health for those at qualifying income levels. Above 200% FPL, Marketplace Qualified Health Plans take over, with ACA premium tax credits available up to 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person in 2026). The trade-off moving from Essential Plan to QHP is significant: a person at 250% FPL who lost their Essential Plan on July 1, 2026 could expect to pay $100 to $300 per month in net premiums after tax credits on a Silver plan, plus a deductible of $1,500 to $4,500 before full coverage kicks in. NY State negotiated a mid-year deductible reduction for those transitioning from Essential Plan to QHP, cutting the annual deductible in half. For families with children, Child Health Plus (New York's CHIP program) covers children under 19 at incomes up to 400% FPL with sliding-scale premiums from $0 to $60 per month regardless of the parents' coverage status.
body.es: Tres niveles distintos de cobertura estan disponibles a traves de NY State of Health en 2026, y cual aplica depende casi enteramente de su ingreso proyectado actual. Medicaid completo cubre a cualquier persona en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza en Nueva York, lo que significa $22,025 o menos para una sola persona. Medicaid en Nueva York cobra $0 en primas y $0 a $1 en la mayoria de copagos; la inscripcion es todo el ano sin fecha limite. El Plan Esencial es el Programa Basico de Salud de Nueva York que cubre ingresos entre 138% y 200% FPL ($22,025 a $31,920 para una sola persona en 2026). Los inscritos en el Plan Esencial pagan $0 en primas mensuales y enfrentan un limite de copago anual de aproximadamente $200. La inscripcion en el Plan Esencial tambien es todo el ano a traves de NY State of Health. Por encima del 200% FPL, los Planes de Salud Calificados del Mercado toman el relevo, con creditos fiscales de prima ACA disponibles hasta el 400% FPL. El intercambio al pasar del Plan Esencial al Plan Calificado es significativo: una persona al 250% FPL que perdio su Plan Esencial el 1 de julio de 2026 podria esperar pagar $100 a $300 por mes en primas netas despues de creditos fiscales en un plan Silver, mas un deducible de $1,500 a $4,500 antes de que entre en vigor la cobertura completa.

intro.en: The costliest mistakes people make after losing NY Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas costosos que la gente comete despues de perder la cobertura de Medicaid o Plan Esencial de NY en 2026:

items.en: Using healthcare.gov to enroll instead of NY State of Health. New York is a state-based Marketplace. All Medicaid, Essential Plan, and QHP enrollments for New York residents must go through nystateofhealth.ny.gov or 1-855-355-5777. Healthcare.gov will not process your application.
items.es: Usar healthcare.gov para inscribirse en lugar de NY State of Health. Nueva York es un Mercado basado en el estado. Todas las inscripciones de Medicaid, Plan Esencial y Plan Calificado para residentes de Nueva York deben pasar por nystateofhealth.ny.gov o 1-855-355-5777.

items.en: Assuming your income is too high for the Essential Plan without checking. The Essential Plan threshold is 200% FPL ($31,920 for a single person in 2026). Many people at 200-250% FPL lost the 250%-tier Essential Plan on July 1, 2026, but those who had a drop in income may now re-qualify at the 138-200% FPL tier with $0 premiums.
items.es: Asumir que sus ingresos son demasiado altos para el Plan Esencial sin verificar. El umbral del Plan Esencial es el 200% FPL ($31,920 para una sola persona en 2026). Muchas personas al 200-250% FPL perdieron el Plan Esencial del nivel 250% el 1 de julio de 2026, pero quienes tuvieron una caida en los ingresos pueden recalificar ahora al nivel 138-200% FPL con primas de $0.

items.en: Waiting until after August 30, 2026 to enroll in a Marketplace QHP for the July Essential Plan cut. NY State of Health set August 30, 2026 as the practical enrollment deadline for July 1 coverage transitions. Applications after that date may still qualify through September 29, 2026 under the full 90-day window, but start dates push to October 1.
items.es: Esperar hasta despues del 30 de agosto de 2026 para inscribirse en un Plan Calificado del Mercado para el corte del Plan Esencial de julio. NY State of Health establecio el 30 de agosto de 2026 como la fecha limite practica de inscripcion para las transiciones de cobertura del 1 de julio.

items.en: Not checking children's Child Health Plus eligibility. New York's Child Health Plus covers children under 19 at incomes up to 400% FPL ($132,000 for a family of 4 in 2026) with $0 to $60 per month in premiums. Parents who lost Essential Plan coverage can still enroll their children in Child Health Plus year-round regardless of the parents' own coverage status.
items.es: No verificar la elegibilidad de Child Health Plus para los ninos. Child Health Plus de Nueva York cubre ninos menores de 19 anos en familias con ingresos hasta el 400% FPL ($132,000 para una familia de 4 en 2026) con $0 a $60 por mes en primas.

items.en: Reporting annual income from last year's 1040 when current-year income is lower. Medicaid and Essential Plan eligibility uses Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) projected for the current year. If your income dropped in 2026, report your projected current-year income, not your 2025 tax return figure.
items.es: Reportar el ingreso anual del formulario 1040 del ano pasado cuando el ingreso del ano actual es menor. La elegibilidad para Medicaid y Plan Esencial usa el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para el ano actual. Si sus ingresos bajaron en 2026, reporte su ingreso proyectado del ano actual, no su cifra de la declaracion de impuestos de 2025.

items.en: Going uninsured and assuming the gap will not matter. A hospital visit during an uninsured gap can result in thousands of dollars in medical bills. Use the 90-day SEP window. Medicaid and Essential Plan applications can often be processed within days.
items.es: Quedarse sin seguro asumiendo que la brecha no importara. Una visita al hospital durante una brecha sin seguro puede resultar en miles de dolares en facturas medicas. Use la ventana SEP de 90 dias. Las solicitudes de Medicaid y Plan Esencial a menudo se pueden procesar en dias.

heading.en: What Changed on July 1, 2026: Essential Plan Income Limit Cut
heading.es: Que Cambio el 1 de Julio de 2026: Recorte del Limite de Ingresos del Plan Esencial

paragraphs.en: New York's Essential Plan operated under a Section 1332 State Innovation Waiver that allowed the state to expand Essential Plan eligibility up to 250% of the Federal Poverty Level, covering roughly 1.75 million New Yorkers by late 2024. Federal law H.R. 1, signed in July 2025, eliminated premium tax credit eligibility for most lawfully present immigrants. This eliminated the federal funding stream that made the 250% FPL expansion financially viable. CMS approved New York's application to terminate the Section 1332 waiver and return to Basic Health Program (BHP) authority in March 2026. Under BHP authority, Essential Plan eligibility is capped at 200% FPL. The transition preserves coverage for approximately 1.3 million New Yorkers at or below 200% FPL under BHP, while removing the roughly 450,000 enrollees at 200-250% FPL from Essential Plan eligibility effective July 1, 2026.
paragraphs.es: El Plan Esencial de Nueva York operaba bajo una Exencion de Innovacion Estatal de la Seccion 1332 que permitia al estado ampliar la elegibilidad del Plan Esencial hasta el 250% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, cubriendo a aproximadamente 1.75 millones de neoyorquinos a finales de 2024. La ley federal H.R. 1, firmada en julio de 2025, elimino la elegibilidad al credito fiscal de prima para la mayoria de los inmigrantes legalmente presentes. CMS aprobo la solicitud de Nueva York de terminar la exencion de la Seccion 1332 y regresar a la autoridad del Programa Basico de Salud (BHP) en marzo de 2026.

paragraphs.en: People at exactly 200% FPL face no change: their Essential Plan coverage continues under the BHP authority. People between 200% and 250% FPL ($31,920 to $39,900 for a single person in 2026) lost their plans June 30, 2026. Those individuals must now enroll in Marketplace Qualified Health Plans through NY State of Health. ACA Marketplace premium tax credits are available at that income range, but the subsidy cliff at 400% FPL and the absence of enhanced premium tax credits means net premiums are higher in 2026 than they would have been in 2024 or 2025. NY State is working with insurers to offer mid-year reduced deductibles for Essential Plan to QHP transitions so that new enrollees do not face a full-year deductible starting mid-year.
paragraphs.es: Las personas exactamente al 200% FPL no enfrentan ningun cambio: su cobertura del Plan Esencial continua bajo la autoridad BHP. Las personas entre el 200% y el 250% FPL ($31,920 a $39,900 para una sola persona en 2026) perdieron sus planes el 30 de junio de 2026. Esas personas ahora deben inscribirse en Planes de Salud Calificados del Mercado a traves de NY State of Health.

heading.en: NY Medicaid Renewal Redeterminations in 2026: Who Gets Removed and What to Do
heading.es: Redeterminaciones de Renovacion Medicaid NY en 2026: Quien es Eliminado y Que Hacer

paragraphs.en: Medicaid unwinding from the COVID continuous enrollment protections officially ended December 31, 2025. Beginning January 1, 2026, New York Medicaid operates under normal redetermination cycles. New York processes annual Medicaid renewals for most enrollees, with notice mailed 60-90 days before the renewal due date. Enrollees removed from Medicaid in 2026 may be removed for procedural reasons (outdated address, did not return renewal paperwork, income not verified) or substantive eligibility reasons (income increased above 138% FPL). Federal H.R. 1 also requires Medicaid redeterminations for expansion-eligible adults to occur twice per year starting December 31, 2026, meaning New Yorkers could face semi-annual renewal checks starting in 2027.
paragraphs.es: El desenrollamiento de Medicaid de las protecciones de inscripcion continua de COVID termino oficialmente el 31 de diciembre de 2025. A partir del 1 de enero de 2026, el Medicaid de Nueva York opera bajo ciclos normales de redeterminacion. Nueva York procesa renovaciones anuales de Medicaid para la mayoria de los inscritos, con avisos enviados por correo 60-90 dias antes de la fecha de vencimiento de la renovacion. La ley H.R. 1 tambien requiere redeterminaciones de Medicaid para adultos elegibles de expansion que se realicen dos veces al ano a partir del 31 de diciembre de 2026.

paragraphs.en: New Yorkers removed from Medicaid for procedural reasons should appeal immediately. New York Medicaid allows enrollees to request a fair hearing within 60 days of a termination notice and to continue benefits while the hearing is pending. Medicaid fair hearings in New York are administered through the Office of Temporary and Disability Assistance (OTDA). Call 1-800-342-3715 or visit otda.ny.gov to request a hearing. If removal was for substantive income reasons, the 90-day SEP for Marketplace QHP enrollment applies. Medicaid re-enrollment remains year-round if income drops back below 138% FPL.
paragraphs.es: Los neoyorquinos eliminados de Medicaid por razones de procedimiento deben apelar de inmediato. El Medicaid de Nueva York permite a los inscritos solicitar una audiencia imparcial dentro de los 60 dias de un aviso de terminacion y continuar recibiendo beneficios mientras la audiencia esta pendiente. Llame al 1-800-342-3715 o visite otda.ny.gov para solicitar una audiencia.

heading.en: State-Specific Rules: NY Essential Plan, Child Health Plus, and Marketplace Brands
heading.es: Reglas Especificas del Estado: Plan Esencial NY, Child Health Plus y Marcas del Mercado

paragraphs.en: New York runs several distinctive coverage programs not found in most other states. NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) is New York's official ACA Marketplace and enrollment portal for all coverage types including Medicaid, Essential Plan, Child Health Plus, and Qualified Health Plans. New Yorkers should never use healthcare.gov to enroll; it cannot process New York applications. Child Health Plus is New York's branded CHIP program covering children under 19 at incomes up to 400% FPL with premiums on a sliding scale from $0 to $60 per month. Enrollment is year-round. The Essential Plan is New York's Basic Health Program covering adults at 138-200% FPL with $0 premiums; enrollment through NY State of Health. Medicaid in New York is administered by the Department of Health through county social services offices and through NY State of Health online.
paragraphs.es: Nueva York tiene varios programas de cobertura distintivos que no se encuentran en la mayoria de otros estados. NY State of Health (nystateofhealth.ny.gov) es el Mercado ACA oficial de Nueva York y el portal de inscripcion para todos los tipos de cobertura incluidos Medicaid, Plan Esencial, Child Health Plus y Planes de Salud Calificados. Los neoyorquinos nunca deben usar healthcare.gov para inscribirse; no puede procesar solicitudes de Nueva York. Child Health Plus es el programa CHIP de marca de Nueva York que cubre ninos menores de 19 anos con ingresos hasta el 400% FPL. El Plan Esencial es el Programa Basico de Salud de Nueva York que cubre a adultos al 138-200% FPL con primas de $0.

paragraphs.en: Key enrollment carriers for Qualified Health Plans on the NY State of Health Marketplace in 2026 include EmblemHealth, Healthfirst, MetroPlus Health Plan, Excellus BlueCross BlueShield, MVP Health Care, and others depending on region. Carriers differ by county: New York City has more plan choices than upstate regions. When selecting a Qualified Health Plan after losing Essential Plan coverage, check whether your current providers are in-network before enrolling, as Essential Plan networks and QHP networks may differ even within the same insurer. NY State of Health enrollment assisters and Navigators are available at no cost. Find a local assister at nystateofhealth.ny.gov/legallyQualifiedNavigators or call 1-855-355-5777.
paragraphs.es: Los principales aseguradoras para Planes de Salud Calificados en el Mercado de NY State of Health en 2026 incluyen EmblemHealth, Healthfirst, MetroPlus Health Plan, Excellus BlueCross BlueShield, MVP Health Care y otros dependiendo de la region. Cuando seleccione un Plan de Salud Calificado despues de perder la cobertura del Plan Esencial, verifique si sus proveedores actuales estan en la red antes de inscribirse.

heading.en: Documents You Need and Why: A Deeper Look
heading.es: Documentos que Necesita y Por Que: Una Mirada Mas Profunda

paragraphs.en: The Medicaid or Essential Plan termination letter is the most critical document for accessing the 90-day SEP. This letter establishes the qualifying life event date. Without it, NY State of Health may require additional proof that you had coverage and lost it involuntarily. If you did not receive a termination letter, call 1-855-355-5777 or log in to your NY State of Health account to download a coverage history record. The Social Security number for each household member is required for identity verification and to check for other programs you or household members may qualify for (including Child Health Plus for children). Proof of current income matters because Medicaid and Essential Plan use Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI) based on the current year's projected earnings. Use pay stubs from the last 30 days. If you are self-employed, NY State of Health may accept a signed statement of projected income. Immigration documents are required for lawfully present immigrants who are not yet US citizens; New York Medicaid and Essential Plan serve many immigration categories including DACA recipients, lawful permanent residents, and refugees.
paragraphs.es: La carta de terminacion de Medicaid o Plan Esencial es el documento mas critico para acceder al SEP de 90 dias. Esta carta establece la fecha del evento calificador de vida. Sin ella, NY State of Health puede requerir prueba adicional de que tenia cobertura y la perdio involuntariamente. El numero de Seguro Social de cada miembro del hogar es necesario para la verificacion de identidad y para verificar otros programas para los que usted o los miembros del hogar pueden calificar.

en.question: What is the SEP window if I lost NY Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage?
en.answer: Loss of Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage triggers a 90-day Special Enrollment Period (SEP) at NY State of Health. For example, if your Essential Plan ended June 30, 2026, your SEP runs July 1 through September 29, 2026. NY State of Health confirmed August 30, 2026 as the enrollment deadline for the July 1 Essential Plan coverage transition to secure a July or August coverage start date. The 90-day window is longer than the standard 60-day SEP that applies to most other qualifying events.

en.question: How do I document the loss of my NY Essential Plan or Medicaid for the SEP application?
en.answer: Your Medicaid or Essential Plan termination letter is the primary documentation. This letter shows the coverage end date and the reason for termination. Log in to nystateofhealth.ny.gov or call 1-855-355-5777 to request a coverage termination notice if you did not receive one by mail. You will select 'lost Medicaid or Essential Plan coverage' as your qualifying life event when applying for a Marketplace Qualified Health Plan. You may also be asked to submit your termination letter by uploading it to your NY State of Health account.

en.question: What if I miss the 90-day SEP window for my lost NY Medicaid or Essential Plan?
en.answer: Missing the 90-day SEP means you cannot enroll in a Marketplace Qualified Health Plan until the next ACA Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through January 15 each year for coverage starting January 1 of the following year. However, Medicaid and Essential Plan enrollment remain year-round for those who qualify. If your income dropped below 138% FPL ($22,025 for one person in 2026), apply for Medicaid at any time at nystateofhealth.ny.gov. If between 138% and 200% FPL, apply for the Essential Plan year-round.

en.question: Will I get retroactive coverage if I enroll during the SEP after losing Essential Plan coverage?
en.answer: For Marketplace Qualified Health Plans, coverage is prospective, not retroactive. Your new QHP coverage typically starts the first of the month following your enrollment date. For the July 1, 2026 Essential Plan transition, NY State of Health set an August 1 coverage start for those enrolling by August 1, and a September 1 start for those enrolling August 2 through August 30. Medicaid in New York can in some cases provide retroactive coverage for up to 3 months before the application date if you were eligible but not enrolled, though this depends on income documentation and county review.

en.question: What options do I have if my income is between 200% and 400% FPL after losing my Essential Plan?
en.answer: Income between 200% and 400% FPL ($31,920 to $63,840 for one person in 2026) qualifies for ACA premium tax credits in a Marketplace Qualified Health Plan through NY State of Health. Silver plans provide the best value for most people in this income range because Silver plans unlock Cost-Sharing Reductions for incomes under 250% FPL. Gold plans make sense if you have high medical needs. The 400% FPL subsidy cliff returned in 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits expired, so incomes above $63,840 for one person receive no federal subsidy. Check your net premium estimate at nystateofhealth.ny.gov before selecting a plan.

en.question: What state-specific rules apply in New York for Medicaid and Essential Plan enrollment?
en.answer: New York operates its own state-based Marketplace called NY State of Health at nystateofhealth.ny.gov. All Medicaid, Essential Plan, Child Health Plus, and Marketplace QHP enrollments must go through this portal or by calling 1-855-355-5777. Do not use healthcare.gov for New York coverage. New York also offers Child Health Plus (its CHIP program) for children under 19 at up to 400% FPL. New York Medicaid expanded under the ACA and covers adults up to 138% FPL. The Essential Plan covers adults 138-200% FPL under BHP authority as of July 1, 2026.

en.question: Do I qualify for Medicaid after losing my NY Essential Plan in 2026?
en.answer: Medicaid eligibility in New York requires income at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level: $22,025 for one person, $29,863 for two people, $37,702 for three, or $45,540 for a family of 4 in 2026. If your income falls at or below these thresholds, apply for Medicaid at nystateofhealth.ny.gov any time during the year with no SEP deadline. Medicaid covers a broader benefit package than the Essential Plan and costs nothing. If your income is above 138% FPL but at or below 200% FPL ($31,920 for one person in 2026), you qualify for the Essential Plan with $0 premiums.

en.question: What happens to my children's coverage if I lose my NY Essential Plan or Medicaid?
en.answer: Children under 19 in New York may qualify for Child Health Plus (New York's CHIP program) at incomes up to 400% FPL ($132,000 for a family of 4 in 2026). Child Health Plus premiums range from $0 to $60 per month depending on income. Enrollment is year-round. Children may also qualify for full Medicaid if household income is under 138% FPL. The child's eligibility is evaluated separately from the parent's. Even if you as a parent must enroll in a Marketplace QHP, your children may still qualify for Medicaid or Child Health Plus at no cost or low cost. Call 1-855-355-5777 to check children's eligibility.

es.question: Cual es la ventana del SEP si perdi la cobertura Medicaid o Plan Esencial de NY?
es.answer: La perdida de cobertura Medicaid o Plan Esencial activa un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial (SEP) de 90 dias en NY State of Health. Por ejemplo, si su Plan Esencial termino el 30 de junio de 2026, su SEP va del 1 de julio al 29 de septiembre de 2026. NY State of Health confirmo el 30 de agosto de 2026 como la fecha limite de inscripcion para la transicion de cobertura del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio para asegurar una fecha de inicio de cobertura en julio o agosto. La ventana de 90 dias es mas larga que el SEP estandar de 60 dias.

es.question: Como documento la perdida de mi Plan Esencial o Medicaid de NY para la solicitud del SEP?
es.answer: Su carta de terminacion de Medicaid o Plan Esencial es la documentacion principal. Esta carta muestra la fecha de fin de cobertura y el motivo de la terminacion. Inicie sesion en nystateofhealth.ny.gov o llame al 1-855-355-5777 para solicitar un aviso de terminacion si no recibio uno por correo. Seleccionara 'perdida de cobertura Medicaid o Plan Esencial' como su evento calificador de vida al solicitar un Plan de Salud Calificado del Mercado.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo la ventana SEP de 90 dias para mi Medicaid o Plan Esencial de NY perdido?
es.answer: Perder el SEP de 90 dias significa que no puede inscribirse en un Plan de Salud Calificado del Mercado hasta el proximo Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta del ACA, que va del 1 de noviembre al 15 de enero cada ano para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero del ano siguiente. Sin embargo, la inscripcion en Medicaid y Plan Esencial permanece todo el ano para quienes califican. Si su ingreso bajo por debajo del 138% FPL ($22,025 para una persona en 2026), solicite Medicaid en cualquier momento en nystateofhealth.ny.gov.

es.question: Obtendre cobertura retroactiva si me inscribo durante el SEP despues de perder la cobertura del Plan Esencial?
es.answer: Para los Planes de Salud Calificados del Mercado, la cobertura es prospectiva, no retroactiva. Su nueva cobertura QHP generalmente comienza el primero del mes siguiente a su fecha de inscripcion. Para la transicion del Plan Esencial del 1 de julio de 2026, NY State of Health establecio un inicio de cobertura del 1 de agosto para quienes se inscriban antes del 1 de agosto, y un inicio del 1 de septiembre para quienes se inscriban del 2 al 30 de agosto. Medicaid en Nueva York puede en algunos casos proporcionar cobertura retroactiva de hasta 3 meses.

es.question: Que opciones tengo si mi ingreso esta entre el 200% y el 400% FPL despues de perder mi Plan Esencial?
es.answer: Los ingresos entre el 200% y el 400% FPL ($31,920 a $63,840 para una persona en 2026) califican para creditos fiscales de prima ACA en un Plan de Salud Calificado del Mercado a traves de NY State of Health. Los planes Silver proporcionan el mejor valor para la mayoria de personas en este rango de ingresos porque los planes Silver desbloquean Reducciones de Costos Compartidos para ingresos bajo el 250% FPL. El precipicio del subsidio del 400% FPL volvio en 2026 despues de que expiraron los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados.

es.question: Que reglas especificas del estado aplican en Nueva York para la inscripcion en Medicaid y Plan Esencial?
es.answer: Nueva York opera su propio Mercado basado en el estado llamado NY State of Health en nystateofhealth.ny.gov. Todas las inscripciones de Medicaid, Plan Esencial, Child Health Plus y Plan Calificado del Mercado deben pasar por este portal o llamando al 1-855-355-5777. No use healthcare.gov para cobertura de Nueva York. Nueva York tambien ofrece Child Health Plus (su programa CHIP) para ninos menores de 19 anos hasta el 400% FPL.

es.question: Califico para Medicaid despues de perder mi Plan Esencial de NY en 2026?
es.answer: La elegibilidad para Medicaid en Nueva York requiere ingresos en o por debajo del 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza: $22,025 para una persona, $29,863 para dos, $37,702 para tres, o $45,540 para una familia de 4 en 2026. Si sus ingresos estan en o por debajo de estos umbrales, solicite Medicaid en nystateofhealth.ny.gov en cualquier momento del ano sin fecha limite del SEP. Si su ingreso esta por encima del 138% FPL pero en o por debajo del 200% FPL ($31,920 para una persona en 2026), califica para el Plan Esencial con primas de $0.

es.question: Que pasa con la cobertura de mis hijos si pierdo mi Plan Esencial o Medicaid de NY?
es.answer: Los ninos menores de 19 anos en Nueva York pueden calificar para Child Health Plus (el programa CHIP de Nueva York) con ingresos hasta el 400% FPL ($132,000 para una familia de 4 en 2026). Las primas de Child Health Plus van de $0 a $60 por mes dependiendo del ingreso. La inscripcion es todo el ano. Los ninos tambien pueden calificar para Medicaid completo si el ingreso del hogar esta bajo el 138% FPL. La elegibilidad del nino se evalua por separado de la del padre. Llame al 1-855-355-5777 para verificar la elegibilidad de los ninos.
